org_not_member.hint: Pick one of the organizations you belong to.

org_required.hint: Create or join an organization in the web app first.

org_visible_destination.hint: Confirm with acknowledge_org_visible=true, or pick a destination of this project.

organization_required.hint: Ask an admin to add you to an organization, then sign in again.

organization_warehouse_unmapped.hint: Contact support; the organization maps to no warehouse database.

outbox_full.hint: Retry in a moment; the service refuses writes while its event queue catches up.

owner_answer_invalid.hint: Ask an engineer to check that the staff console and the service run the same release.

owner_answer_mismatch.hint: Ask an engineer to compare this request with the service's own audit log.

owner_unavailable.hint: Try again in a minute; an apply sent again with the same key never applies twice.

password_code_attempts_exhausted.hint: Send a new code, then enter the one in the new email.

password_code_expired.hint: Send a new code, then enter the one in the new email.

password_code_invalid.hint: Check the code in the latest email and enter it again.

password_code_not_mailable.hint: Send a new code from the password dialog; this one was replaced or used.

password_code_resend_too_soon.hint: Wait for the Retry-After interval, then send a new code.

password_code_send_limit.hint: Wait for the Retry-After interval, then send a new code.

password_email_missing.hint: Ask an admin to add an email address to your account.

password_policy_refused.hint: Choose a password that meets the rule the answer names.

payg_not_allowed.hint: Move the organization to a plan that allows overage, or keep within the limit.

permission_denied.hint: Ask an admin for the role this action needs.

personal_login_dropping.hint: Your previous login for this warehouse is still being removed; try again in a minute.

personal_login_exists.hint: Rotate your existing login for this warehouse to get a new password.

personal_logins_disabled.hint: Ask a project admin to turn on personal logins for this project.

pipe_already_exists.hint: Pick another destination table, or use the pipe named by existing_pipe_uuid.

pipe_busy.hint: Another change to this pipe is running; retry in a few seconds.

pipe_deleting.hint: Create a new pipe if you still need one; this one is being deleted.

pipe_lookup_failed.hint: Retry; the delete waits until the pipelines using it are known.

pipe_not_failed.hint: Release a pipe only once it has failed; resync or pause a running one instead.

pipe_not_found.hint: List the pipes and pick one you can see.

pipe_not_ready.hint: Wait until the pipe is active (retry it if it failed), then try again.

pipe_not_retriable.hint: Read current_status; only a failed pipe can be retried.

pipe_not_scheduled.hint: Resume the pipe or give it a run schedule first.

pipe_restart_unsupported.hint: Wait for the pipe's next scheduled run instead; this engine retries on its own schedule.

pipe_retry_too_soon.hint: Wait retry_after_seconds, then retry the pipe.

pipe_shares_reader.hint: Delete or move the other pipes of the reader first.

pipeline_editor_required.hint: Ask for Project Editor on every pipeline that uses the source, or delete those pipelines first.

pipes_present.hint: Delete the pipelines that use the warehouse first.

plan_exists.hint: Pick another name, or replace the existing plan.

plan_file_invalid.hint: Fix the problems listed in the plan file.

plan_seed_invalid.hint: Ask an operator to fix the built-in plan seed.

plan_source_limit.hint: Contact us for a plan with more sources.

policy_apply_failed.hint: The metric model is not updating; ask your org admin to check access.

preview_expired.hint: Preview the change again, then apply it within five minutes.

preview_mismatch.hint: Apply the change exactly as previewed, or preview the new change first.

preview_not_found.hint: Preview the change again and apply the new preview.

principal_disabled.hint: Ask a project admin to enable this login, then rotate it for a new password.

project_admin_required.hint: Ask a project admin to do this, or to make you a project admin.

project_conflict.hint: Send one project: X-Databay-Project-ID must match the route and the body.

project_forbidden.hint: Pick another project or ask a project admin for access.

project_general_immutable.hint: Use another project; General cannot be renamed, deleted, restricted or have its members changed.

project_live_graph_immutable.hint: Leave the items that have live pipelines unchanged, or delete those pipelines first.

project_models_broken.hint: Fix the models listed in broken_models first, then save again.

project_not_deleting.hint: Check the project's state; this call applies only to a project being deleted.

project_not_empty.hint: Move or delete its pipelines and resources, or ask an org admin for a forced delete.

project_not_found.hint: Pick a project you can see; this one does not exist, is being deleted, or is not visible to you.

project_revision_conflict.hint: Reload the canvas to get the current revision, reapply your change, then save again.

property_id_invalid.hint: Send the numeric GA4 property id.

property_not_readable.hint: Grant the key Viewer access on the property, then try again.

publication_mode_locked.hint: Keep the current choice, or delete this source's pipelines before changing it.

publication_mode_not_applicable.hint: Leave the publication choice out: only Postgres sources have one.

publication_mode_unset.hint: Choose who creates the publication on the source, then create the pipeline.

publication_mode_unsupported.hint: Choose the path where Databay creates the publication, or move to the native engine and Postgres 13.

publication_modes_off.hint: Leave the publication choice out: on this deployment Databay creates the publication.

qualifier_rewrite_failed.hint: Ask again, or write the query in the SQL editor.

query_rejected.hint: Fix the query as detail says.

query_timeout.hint: Narrow the query or add filters so it finishes in time.

question_failed.hint: Ask again, or write the query in the SQL editor.

quota_exceeded.hint: Wait until the hourly query limit resets, then try again.

quota_reached.hint: Delete one to make room, or ask whoever lift_by names to raise the limit in quota.

reader_conflict.hint: Ask your Databay administrator to check this warehouse's reader.

reader_engine_mismatch.hint: Create the pipe without reader_id, or switch the reader to this pipe's engine first.

reader_full.hint: Create the pipe without reader_id to give it a reader of its own.

reader_partition_conflict.hint: Create the pipe without reader_id to give it a reader of its own.

reader_password_missing.hint: Ask your Databay administrator to rotate this warehouse's reader.

reader_publication_mode_mismatch.hint: Create the pipe without reader_id; it then gets a reader of its own.

reader_scope_required.hint: Send the request again with "scope": "reader"; the answer lists the pipes it changes.

reason_required.hint: Say why you are making the change, then send it again.

reason_too_short.hint: Say why you are making the change in at least 15 characters.

rebuild_in_progress.hint: Wait for the pipe's open rebuild or migration to finish, then try again.

rebuild_source_invalid.hint: Pick a rebuild source this pipe supports.

reconnect_different_account.hint: Pick the source's own account when reconnecting.

reconnect_different_login.hint: Sign in again with the login this source was set up with.

reconnect_wrong_type.hint: Reconnect with a source of the same type.

removed_setting.hint: Ask an operator to remove the setting named in setting from the environment.

replication_key_outside_identity.hint: Choose a replication key within the reader's identity columns, or create the pipe without reader_id.

request_invalid.hint: Fix the fields the answer names, then send the request again.

requires_support.hint: Contact Databay support to accept this check.

reset_mail_unavailable.hint: Ask an operator to set the realm's mail server, then reset the password again.

resource_not_found.hint: Check the resource id; it is not in your organization.

resource_not_shared.hint: Share it into the project from the project that manages it.

resource_not_visible.hint: Check the id and the active project; the resource does not exist or is not visible to you.

resync_required.hint: Resync the pipe with the call named in next; resuming cannot bring back the missing changes.

retry_cooldown.hint: Wait retry_after_s, then retry the warehouse.

revision_conflict.hint: Reload the dashboard to get the current revision, reapply your change, then save again.

rollout_off_cli_only.hint: Ask an operator to change it with the operator CLI.

row_count_unavailable.hint: Try again in a moment; until the warehouse answers, the count is unknown.

row_filter_invalid.hint: Fix the filter condition the error names so its column exists and its value fits the column type.

rule_built_relation_unknown.hint: Pick a model from the warehouse's built models.

rule_duplicate_table.hint: Name each table once per warehouse in an access role.

rule_overlap.hint: Keep either one whole-warehouse rule or table rules for each warehouse in a role.

rule_scope_invalid.hint: Name a table for a rule with columns or a row filter, and switch the role to rules before editing them.

rule_table_unknown.hint: Pick a table the warehouse has.

rule_warehouse_not_managed.hint: Pick a warehouse Databay manages for your organization.

rule_warehouse_not_visible.hint: Share the warehouse with this project first, or pick one it can see.

schema_change_unsupported.hint: Change the destination table yourself, or rebuild the pipe's table; it cannot be applied for you.

schema_query_failed.hint: Retry; contact support if the change still cannot be written.

schema_state_stuck_finishing.hint: Contact support with the pipe's id; its rebuild finished but the change did not clear.

schema_state_unknown_combination.hint: Contact support with the pipe's id and the request id.

schema_version_contention.hint: Retry; another apply on the pipe is in progress.

schema_version_not_found.hint: List the pipe's schema history and pick a version it has.

secret_key_missing.hint: Ask your administrator to finish this server's setup.

semantic_unavailable.hint: The numbers are updating; retry in a moment.

service_account_key_invalid.hint: Send a valid service account key.

service_account_needs_access_role.hint: Pick at least one access role for the service account.

service_credential_exists.hint: Rotate the service account's credential for this warehouse to get a new password.

service_not_available.hint: This feature is not part of this Databay product; ask support if you need it.

service_required.hint: Call the public route instead; this one accepts only Databay's own services.

service_updating.hint: Databay is updating; retry in a minute.

session_revoke_failed.hint: Retry in a moment; the change is completed automatically once sign-out succeeds.

setup_script_not_found.hint: Set the source up by hand; this type has no setup script.

setup_step_unknown.hint: Ask for one of the steps the answer lists.

share_in_use.hint: Delete or move those pipelines first; paused pipelines count too.

share_not_found.hint: List the resource's shares and pick one of them.

shared_readers_disabled.hint: Create the pipe without reader_id; it then gets a reader of its own.

shop_not_found.hint: Install the app on a Shopify store first.

shopify_app_not_installed.hint: Install the app for the shop.

shopify_hmac_invalid.hint: Send the request with a valid Shopify HMAC.

shopify_install_failed.hint: Retry the install; contact support if it fails again.

shopify_session_invalid.hint: Reload the app in Shopify admin to get a new session.

shopify_source_undeletable.hint: Uninstall the app from Shopify to remove this source.

shopify_store_not_found.hint: Check the store's address, then try again.

sibling_being_removed.hint: Retry in a few minutes; another account of this type is still being removed.

sink_column_type_required.hint: Retry without sink_column_type; the warehouse picks the column type.

sink_in_use.hint: Delete the pipelines listed in pipes first.

sink_not_found.hint: List the warehouses and pick one you can see.

sink_not_ready.hint: Wait until the destination warehouse is ready (retry it if it failed), then create the pipe again.

sink_provision_failed.hint: Connect again; contact support if it keeps failing.

sink_user_exists.hint: Renew your warehouse user's password instead.

slot_release_failed.hint: Check that the source database is reachable, then release the pipe again.

source_check_run_active.hint: Wait for the running check to finish, then read its result or check again.

source_check_run_not_found.hint: Check the source again to get a new result.

source_check_unreachable.hint: Retry once the source database can be reached.

source_connection_failed.hint: Check the connection details and credentials for the failure detail names, then try again.

source_currency_unknown.hint: Try again once the store's data has synced; contact support if it persists.

source_deleting.hint: Pick another source; this one is being deleted.

source_has_live_pipes.hint: Send settings Databay can connect with; pipelines use this source.

source_host_changed_live_pipe.hint: Delete and re-create the pipe to stream from the new host.

source_in_use.hint: Delete the pipelines listed in pipes first, or cascade-delete.

source_name_taken.hint: Choose a name no other source in your organization uses.

source_needs_attention.hint: Fix the setup checks in blocking_requirements on the source database, then check the source again.

source_needs_reauth.hint: Reconnect the source to sign in again.

source_no_stored_pass.hint: Check the source with its active probes, on its Connect step or with the CLI, then create the pipe.

source_not_renewable.hint: Wait until the source finishes updating; a deleting or uninstalled source cannot be renewed.

source_not_visible.hint: Ask a project admin for access to the projects of these sources.

source_operation_unsupported.hint: Skip this operation; this source or warehouse type cannot do it.

source_override_not_offered.hint: Fix what the check found on the source database, then check the source again.

source_partition_check_unavailable.hint: Retry once the source database can be reached.

source_partitioned_table_unsupported.hint: Create one pipe per partition of the table; a partition added later needs a pipe of its own.

source_pending.hint: Wait for the sources listed in pending to land their first data.

source_read_timeout.hint: Retry; the source database took too long to answer.

source_refresh_used_today.hint: Wait for the daily sync, or refresh again tomorrow.

source_replica_identity_missing.hint: Have the database admin give the table a primary key or a replica identity, then create the pipe again.

source_replication_slots_exhausted.hint: Have the database admin raise max_replication_slots, or delete a pipe you no longer need on that source.

source_setup_incomplete.hint: Fix the setup checks in blocking_requirements on the source database, then check the source again.

source_table_not_found.hint: Pick a table the source database has.

source_teardown_failed.hint: Check the source's pipelines and its database, then delete the source again.

source_type_not_offered.hint: Pick a source type this deployment offers.

source_updating.hint: Retry once the source reports connected.

source_wal_level_not_logical.hint: Have the database admin set wal_level to logical and restart PostgreSQL, then create the pipe again.

staff_action_unknown.hint: Pick one of the actions this install lists.

staff_read_not_served.hint: Ask an engineer to check which service serves this section on this install.

staff_read_unavailable.hint: Try again in a minute; reading changed nothing.

staff_reauth_required.hint: Sign in to the staff console again with your one-time code, then retry.

staff_request_not_found.hint: Check the request key: no staff change was made under it.

staff_required.hint: Sign in to the staff console and retry from there.

stream_not_found.hint: Pick a stream the source has.

subscription_changed.hint: Retry; the subscription changed while this ran.

support_delivery_failed.hint: Retry; the message was not sent.

surface_disabled.hint: Contact support, or whoever runs your Databay server, to turn project scoping on for this surface.

table_checks_failed.hint: Run the SQL shown for each table named, or remove it from this set, then try again.

table_not_found.hint: Pick a table the warehouse has.

token_invalid.hint: Sign in again, or send a valid API key.

token_rejected.hint: Check that the token has not expired and has the needed scopes.

token_stale.hint: Sign in again to get a token with your current roles.

too_many_currencies.hint: Filter the card to fewer currencies.

too_many_properties.hint: Sync fewer properties in this connection.

unknown_dataset.hint: Pick a dataset from the dataset list.

unknown_feature.hint: Use a feature name from the feature list.

unknown_meter.hint: Use a meter name the plan has.

unknown_override_keys.hint: Check each key in unknown, then skip the ones that do not exist.

unknown_plan.hint: List the plans and pick one of them.

unknown_version.hint: List the plan's versions and pick one of them.

unknown_warehouse.hint: Name only warehouses you have in the SQL.

unknown_warehouse_schema.hint: Name one of your warehouses in the schema path.

unsupported_sink.hint: Contact support; this source needs a single-node warehouse, which this deployment does not have.

user_in_other_org.hint: Invite another email address; a person can belong to one organization only.

username_missing.hint: Ask an admin to set a username on your account, then sign in again.

version_in_use.hint: Move the subscriptions off this version first.

version_published.hint: Create a draft from this version and change that instead.

warehouse_credential_rejected.hint: Ask your org admin to re-run the warehouse access reconcile.

warehouse_name_unsafe.hint: Ask your Databay administrator to check this warehouse's database name.

warehouse_not_in_project.hint: Pick a warehouse available in this project.

warehouse_not_queryable.hint: Pick a warehouse Databay manages on your organization's analytics server; only those can be queried.

warehouse_not_visible.hint: Pick a warehouse from this project's list.

warehouse_required.hint: Name one of the project's warehouses.

warehouse_setup_invalid.hint: Ask your Databay administrator to fix the warehouse settings; retrying will not help.

webhook_body_invalid.hint: Send the webhook with every required field.

webhook_forbidden.hint: Send alerts from this project instead.

webhook_replay_unavailable.hint: Send a new Idempotency-Key to create the webhook again.

webhook_signature_invalid.hint: Sign the webhook with the secret shown when the repository was connected.

webhook_url_undeliverable.hint: Use a URL this webhook type can deliver to.

wrong_credentials.hint: Check the username and password, then sign in again.
